purpose: Freeze a fail-closed design for physically isolating label, detector-summary, and path-derived supervision from any model-visible Liwa record, then excluding overlap with protected E3, E5, OpTC, OTRF, and WitFoo material before normalization or sample construction.

control_plane_only: row index or source-native record identifier
program_binder_only: record identity or raw-record content hash
record offset or zero-based row index when no stable record identifier exists
model_view_eligible_only_after_all_gates: explicitly mapped raw-event fields whose field names are neither forbidden supervision nor detector-summary fields
trusted source metadata separately approved by the L2 mapping contract
never_model_visible: source-native attack, technique, TTP, condition, logging-view, scenario, or run label
ground-truth, answer, class, target, gold, support-decision, or other forbidden-supervision column
alert, detection-rule, score, precision, recall, accuracy, confusion-count, or aggregate-statistics column
screenshots, graphs, BloodHound exports, rules, configurations, narratives, and statistical reports

stage_order: Verify the exact frozen archive size and MD5 without changing the selected artifact.
Use the prior safe central-directory manifest or a separately authorized manifest verification; do not infer supervision from member names.
Read only the header needed to compile a field-action map before any row value is materialized.
Classify every field as forbidden_supervision, detector_summary, binder_only, candidate_raw_event, or unknown.
Fail closed on every unknown field until an amended field map is reviewed; denylisted fields always override allowlisted categories.
Stream-decode only candidate_raw_event and binder_only fields; never instantiate denied values in model-view, target, prompt, validator, admission, or training-record objects.
Build the exclusion-only candidate text from candidate_raw_event fields; do not construct normalized packets or supervision.
Run protected exclusion and quarantine all hits before any future normalizer or packet constructor is allowed to observe the record.
Only after a separately authorized clean rescan may a program binder emit an unbound or ambiguous pointer suggestion for downstream validation.

field_name_normalization.algorithm: Unicode NFKC, trim, casefold, then replace each maximal non-alphanumeric run with one underscore and strip leading or trailing underscores
field_name_normalization.matching_rule: A deny token matches only a complete normalized underscore-delimited token or a complete frozen normalized field key; substring matching inside ordinary words is forbidden.

natural_event_text_preservation.policy: Do not delete or rewrite an allowed raw-event scalar merely because its value contains an attack, technique, actor, malware, or condition-like word. Field isolation is decided by field identity and member class, not by keyword censorship of admissible event text.
natural_event_text_preservation.exception: A later protected-exclusion match quarantines the whole record; it does not selectively redact the matching phrase and admit the remainder.

pointer_components: frozen archive digest and record revision
SHA-256 of the normalized member path, never the raw path in model-visible form
source-native record identifier when stable, otherwise zero-based row index plus SHA-256 of raw record bytes
SHA-256 of the admitted source span bytes
verification_rules: The binder must deterministically recompute every pointer component from the frozen archive and selected record.
A missing, duplicate, or non-recomputable record identity yields binding_status=ambiguous and no bound case evidence.
The pointer may be attached only after field isolation and protected exclusion pass for the record.
The LLM may suggest a pointer candidate but cannot set binding_status=bound, write E_case, Promote, or acquire certification authority.

execution_order: Verify the frozen reference-lock file SHA-256 and declared semantic lock before inspecting candidate content.
Compare archive and member content hashes against the protected source-file and manifest hashes for exact artifact overlap.
After field isolation, compute the frozen normalized hash for every model-visible candidate scalar and deterministic record serialization.
For text of at least 16 characters, compute frozen normalized character 5-gram hashes and Jaccard similarity against the 1,177 protected signatures.
Quarantine every exact, normalized, or near-duplicate hit and every future derivative of that record.
Run a post-quarantine rescan over the candidate-admissible set; only zero remaining matches may be reported as exclusion_passed.
exact_checks: candidate archive or member content SHA-256 equals a protected source-file or manifest SHA-256
candidate model-visible scalar or deterministic record serialization SHA-256 equals a protected exact hash when available

required_pre_execution_tests.requirement: A unique canary placed in every forbidden-supervision field is absent from model view, target, prompt, pointer hint, validator input, admission input, logs, and serialized training records.
A path-only attack or logging-condition token cannot influence any learned feature, target, candidate q, modality, or support decision.
An attack-like word naturally present inside an admitted raw event is preserved byte-for-byte unless the whole record is quarantined by protected exclusion.
Unknown headers and deny/allow conflicts fail closed before any row value is materialized.
The program binder reconstructs the same pointer identity from archive digest, member-path hash, member hash, record identity, and span hash without exposing the raw path to the model.
Synthetic exact, normalized-exact, and Jaccard-at-threshold matches are quarantined; a below-threshold control remains eligible.
Changing the threshold, reference-lock hash, normalization, or n-gram size causes a hard contract failure rather than a rescan.

All emitted candidate records retain admission_status=candidate, certification_authority.allowed=false, certification_authority.levels=[], promotion_status=none, and unbound or ambiguous binding status.

allowed_output: record counts by source-native run group
exact, normalized, and near-duplicate match counts
maximum Jaccard value without matched text
forbidden_output: raw Liwa event values or excerpts

success_gate_for_a_future_separately_aut.next_gate: separate quota-capacity, lineage, and source-role admission review

amendment_rules: Any change to the source archive, field-name normalization, deny tokens, protected reference lock, exact or near-duplicate method, threshold, pointer identity, or quarantine unit requires a new versioned contract before execution.
Observed failures may not be repaired by weakening the denylist, lowering the quarantine unit, increasing the near-duplicate threshold, selectively redacting matched text, or fabricating supervision.
Passing this contract cannot change Liwa quota from zero, mark L2 passed, or authorize baseline or fine-tuning.
